Batch 5 — independent candidate review

25 designs reviewed. 17 candidates with limitations; eight unresolved user/package holds. Zero final approvals. No art edited.

Comparison boards: promotional illustration, desktop closed/open, mobile closed/open. Original images independently inspected and bound to immutable parent hashes; boards are scaled evidence, not calibrated material comparisons. No fresh runtime or source-mechanism tests in this QA pass.
